source_hash_binding: Source/test hashes bind to git objects at code_commit, not a later working tree.
implemented_scope: Native PNG save-panel settings for 36–1200 dpi and transparent/opaque paper. Physical paper points remain independent of raster sampling; pixel dimensions and DPI metadata are written explicitly, with dimension and 100-million-pixel checks before allocation. Assigned background artwork remains visible.
Native PDF current/all-foreground/custom-page controls with ordered unique identity-bound selection, duplicate-name disambiguation, Move Up/Down, mixed media boxes and preserved physical geometry.

Export drafts bind owner, state, revision and active page. Actual page activation can preserve drawing revision; switching pages invalidates the displayed draft instead of exporting a different raster page.

Offline bounded preferences pin libraries by source path and VSSX masters by source file plus public master ID, independently of display names and ephemeral preview/card UUIDs. Pins survive preference reload without editing the drawing.

Library browser pin/unpin and pinned-only controls include pinned files across scanned folders. Canonical path deduplication, regular-file/symlink validation and cancellation remain in the existing owned worker. Same-named libraries expose source paths in tooltip/accessibility metadata.

Shapes pane master context menus pin/unpin and a Pinned masters category filters loaded masters. Metadata includes filename, public ID, NameU and source path; search covers these fields. Category identities survive imported libraries named like built-in filters, and preview cards are reused.

regression_dispositions.observation: Initial native action names collided with inherited NSResponder moveUp/moveDown methods. Renamed the PDF selection actions; subsequent compilation passes.

Actual duplicate-title native popup behavior replaced the Pinned masters filter with an imported same-name family; explicit distinct menu items and represented identities fix the collision. Cross-folder test comparison also exposed /var versus /private path spelling; worker canonical identities now deduplicate aliases and tests compare canonical URLs.

Intermediate source passed42 focused tests (2 skips) and the complete866 suite (13 skips). Read-only review subsequently found active-page changes preserve revision, so a dedicated real activation regression and active-page draft binding were added. These runs are historical, not final source qualification.

Final review added same-named library source metadata, actual activation invalidation and checkpoints around canonical-path loops. Final49 focused and full868-test suites pass without native exclusions.

limitations: All204 M3 children and the milestone remain unaccepted. This is partial local engineering, with no integration or publication permission.

Raster settings currently apply to PNG page bounds. Selection/content bounds and additional registered formats/settings remain open. PDF page choices do not implement print ranges, tiling or calibrated printer qualification; SVG and the complete output policy contract remain open.

Pins are bounded offline preferences. The master filter shows already-loaded source masters; favorites are not automatically imported at launch. Missing/unreadable pinned library files are skipped by scanning and have no unavailable-item unpin UI in this slice. Legacy binary stencil metadata remains explicitly incomplete.
Custom imported VSSX identity-preserving create/rename/edit/reorder/delete, cross-library dependency closure/master replacement, and large-library timing/resource qualification remain open.
Remaining relationship/host/function/appearance/Boolean/layout/package production contracts and independent public workflows still require implementation and qualification.

Exact-build licensed Visio/COM, bidirectional no-repair/save/edit qualification, same-font regional comparisons and calibrated physical-printer evidence remain absent. The13 prerequisite skips are not passed evidence. M2 v0.23.4 performance exception does not qualify M3.
